SELECT ic.id, ic.check_no AS checkNo, ic.storage_id AS storageId, s.name AS storageName, ic.creator_id AS creatorId, ic.status, ic.create_time AS createTime, ic.remark FROM inventory_check ic LEFT JOIN storage s ON ic.storage_id = s.id
AND ic.check_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{checkNo}, '%')
AND ic.status = #{status}
ORDER BY ic.create_time DESC, ic.id DESC
